cpu_lowering: Default parsed XLA CPU debug options; no Eigen or pass-disable override.
graph_comparison: Canonical HLO with full constants, backend configuration and control dependencies; ignore instruction identifiers/names and debug metadata.
compile_program: tepl compile inferred.tepl --core --semantic-policy algebraic -o program.json; tepl validate program.json
timing: One untimed warmup per variant; ten paired rounds with rotating variant order. Includes program loading; excludes parsing, cloning, graph comparison, numerical execution, and the diagnostic hook audit. No match/output cache.
